skills.name: short-drama-storyboard
skills.purpose: Turns a Chinese short-drama script and visual bible into storyboard Markdown with dramatic purpose per shot, continuity limits (axis, blocking, eyelines, props) and frozen keyframe prompts.
skills.how_to_use: Ask to break a script into shots / shot table / keyframe prompts; part of a pipeline (short-drama-write -> storyboard -> video-prompts). Chinese-language skill.
skills.evidence: 2.4k stars; most-starred dedicated storyboard skill set; listed in awesome-claude-video-skills

skills.name: baoyu-comic
skills.purpose: Knowledge-comic creator: plans panel layouts, styles and tones for educational/biography/tutorial comics and batch-generates the panel images.
skills.how_to_use: Ask for an educational or biography comic; needs an image-generation backend configured per the baoyu-image-gen skill.
skills.evidence: baoyu-skills (26k stars); claudemarketplaces ~28K installs; also adopted in Hermes Agent

skills.name: sw-workflow
skills.purpose: Orchestrator for a screenwriting skill set: routes a feature, stage play or series through premise -> structure -> character -> scenes -> draft -> revision -> submission, with saved state and story bible.
skills.how_to_use: Install the screenwriting plugin and start a screenplay project; sibling skills supply the craft.
skills.evidence: 1.5k stars; listed in awesome-claude-video-skills scripts section; skills.sh small but growing

skills.name: sw-story-structure
skills.purpose: Screenplay structure distilled from Syd Field, Save the Cat, McKee, Hoxter and others: beat sheets, act/sequence design, inciting incident, crisis-climax-resolution.
skills.how_to_use: Use when outlining or diagnosing a screenplay's structure.

skills.name: sw-scene-craft
skills.purpose: Scene and sequence craft: McKee's scene design and five-step analysis (value turns, beats, subtext), scene types, pacing and image systems.
skills.how_to_use: Use when planning or rewriting individual scenes.

skills.name: short-drama-write
skills.purpose: Writes or revises shootable Chinese short-drama/comic-drama episode scripts, normalises existing scripts and de-templates dialogue before production.
skills.how_to_use: Ask to write/revise an episode from an outline. Chinese-language.

skills.name: cinematic-director
skills.purpose: Director/previs supervisor: turns scripts, prose or keyframes into beat sheets, director's book, blocking, shot list with coverage, storyboard/keyframe prompts, image-to-video motion prompts, sound plans and continuity bibles, with director-style overlays.
skills.how_to_use: Give it a script or scene and ask for a shot list/production plan; no API needed.
skills.evidence: Surfaced by web search for storyboard/shot-list skills; 32KB substantive SKILL.md

skills.name: storytelling
skills.purpose: Builds multi-shot narrative image/video/audio workflows: storyboards, shot lists, multi-prompt video, first-to-last-frame pipelines and sequence continuity on fal.ai.
skills.how_to_use: Use when planning multi-shot generated stories; generation needs FAL_KEY and genmedia CLI.
skills.notes: README says MIT, no LICENSE file.

skills.name: cinematography
skills.purpose: Designs cinematic image/video prompts: shot language, camera movement, lens, lighting, grade, film texture and blocking.
skills.how_to_use: Use when writing shot descriptions for AI video/image; fal key only for generation.
skills.evidence: Official fal.ai community; most-installed fal skill on skills.sh (~860)
skills.notes: README says MIT, no LICENSE file.

skills.name: video
skills.purpose: Creates, audits and splits prompts for AI video generators (Seedance, Kling, Veo, Runway, Sora...) and covers storyboards, shot lists, director treatments, montage, camera, blocking, pacing and continuity.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on AI-video prompt or storyboard requests; no keys needed.

skills.name: h3-storyboard
skills.purpose: Breaks a script into MiniMax H3 shot lists with beat tables, shot counts, expression direction and acting techniques that render well.
skills.how_to_use: Use when breaking scenes into H3 shots or fixing flat performances; targets MiniMax H3 video.
skills.evidence: Created 2026-08-26; top-starred 'storyboard skill' repo created since June 2026; 100KB substantive SKILL.md

skills.name: seedance-2-5-video-director
skills.purpose: Designs and repairs scripts and copy-ready prompts for Dreamina Seedance 2.5: exact-timeline and long videos, multi-grid storyboards, transitions, character locking, acted dialogue.
skills.how_to_use: Use when planning Seedance 2.5 videos; Chinese-first.

skills.name: short-drama-director
skills.purpose: Industrial short-drama/comic-drama pipeline: screenwriting plus audiovisual direction, storyboards and prompts for Seedance 2.x and MiniMax H3, multi-agent.
skills.how_to_use: Chinese-language; use for Douyin/Hongguo-style short dramas.

skills.name: storyboard-creation
skills.purpose: Film/video storyboarding reference: shot types, angles, movement, 180-degree rule, continuity and panel annotation format.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on storyboard / shot list / pre-production; generation optional via inference.sh CLI.
skills.evidence: inference.sh skills (757 stars); claudemarketplaces ~106K installs (likely inflated by mirror forks)
skills.notes: README says MIT, no LICENSE file; installs inflated.

skills.name: script-writer
skills.purpose: Writes production-ready YouTube video scripts after collecting preferences (type, tone, audience, hook, length, humour, storytelling approach) and keeps them for reuse.
skills.how_to_use: Ask for a YouTube script; no prerequisites.

skills.name: ai-video-storyboard
skills.purpose: Plans multi-shot AI videos (>15s) as a coordinated 6-18 shot list with purpose, composition, camera, lighting and consistent copy-ready prompts plus post-production checklist.
skills.how_to_use: Use when an AI video exceeds a single generation length.
skills.evidence: Surfaced by web search and skillsmp; small but focused
skills.notes: README says MIT, no LICENSE file.

skills.name: manage-storyboard-projects
skills.purpose: Creates and edits Agent Storyboard projects over MCP: write scripts and storyboards into a local storyboard app, add/revise shots, aspect ratio, project management.
skills.how_to_use: Requires the repo's local storyboard app + MCP server.

skills.name: video-interaction-mapper
skills.purpose: Turns a UI screen recording into an annotated Figma storyboard: extracts key before/after states, infers triggers and places screenshots with interaction markers.
skills.how_to_use: Use with the Figma MCP server when asked to map a recording's interaction states into Figma.
skills.notes: UI/product storyboards rather than film; no repo license -> link-only.

skills.name: video-shots
skills.purpose: Shot-by-shot breakdown ('拉片') of a finished video: ffmpeg scene detection for cuts/durations, model judges shot size, category, camera move and rhythm.
skills.how_to_use: Give it a reference video to reverse-engineer its shot list; needs ffmpeg. Chinese-first.

skills.name: film-storyboard-skill
skills.purpose: Creates storyboards from scripts and generates beat-board/sequence-board image prompts for Nano Banana, Midjourney or Gemini; sibling scriptwriter, animator and review skills.
skills.how_to_use: Use in the AI-Storyboard project setup.
skills.evidence: Surfaced via web search and claudeskills.club

skills.name: storyboard
skills.purpose: Creates a six-frame storyboard of a user's journey from problem to solution for product alignment and concept reviews (UX storyboard, not film).
skills.how_to_use: Use for product narratives/demos.
